text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
A glorious victory for the "Overlord"! 
—Thank you for the fierce battle, worthy 
rival! —Thank you for the praise, dear 
audience!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
However... I am a king aiming to become 
the "End of the Century Overlord." I must 
make my position as the strongest of my 
generation unshakable—

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And so, taking the next step forward... 
they set their sights on the Japanese 
Derby, a stage worthy of proclaiming a 
King!
